attachments.name: Item Report
attachments.text:
City of Franklin 109 3rd Ave S.
Franklin, TN 37064
(615) 791-3217
File #: 21-0861
DATE: October 11, 2024
TO: Board of Mayor and Aldermen
FROM: Eric Stuckey, City Administrator
Steve Grubb, Director of Streets
Jerry Hatcher, Director of Streets
SUBJECT:
Sole-Source Purchase From Sutphen Towers, Inc. Of Hilliard, Ohio Of Repairs To Fire Apparatus
(Ladder 3) In The Total Amount Of $64,003.42 For The Fleet Division Of The Streets Department
PURPOSE:
The purpose of this procurement is to purchase repairs to Fire apparatus (Ladder 3).
BACKGROUND/STAFF COMMENTS:
City Purchasing Policy allows for the following category of sole-source purchases valued at or greater
than $50,000 not to require individual authorization by the Board of Mayor and Aldermen (but which
shall be reported to the Board): repairs to, maintenance of, licenses for and/or maintenance
agreements for products already in use by the City, so long as the product manufacturer
representative has stated in writing that the vendor is the sole source available to the City, and so
long as the vendor has stated in writing that the quoted pricing is the lowest municipal unit pricing
available at that time and in the foreseeable future for the quantity indicated.
Staff has concluded that the purchase qualifies as a sole-source purchase. Evidence to support this
conclusion includes that the repairs needed to be made by the manufacturer, namely Sutphen, in
case any of the repairs would be covered under warranty. Sutphen Towers, Inc. is a division of
Sutphen. Sutphen Towers, Inc. has indicated in writing that the quoted unit pricing is the lowest unit
pricing possible for Tennessee municipalities at this time and in the foreseeable future for the
quantity indicated.
FINANCIAL IMPACT:
The cost of these repairs to Fire Ladder 3 is $64,003.42.
RECOMMENDATION:
City of Franklin Page 1 of 2
Staff recommends that the Board of Mayor and Aldermen acknowledge receipt of this report of sole-
source purchase from Sutphen Towers, Inc. of repairs to Fire Ladder 3 in the total amount of
$64,003.42 for the Fleet Division of the Streets Department.

matters.title: Sole-Source Purchase Of Primary Metering Cabinet With Middle Tennessee Electric

attachments.name: Signed City of Franklin Letter for Cabinets
attachments.text:
August 18, 2026
Michelle Hatcher
Director of Water Management
City of Franklin Water Management
109 3rd Avenue South
Franklin, TN 37064
Subject: Metering Cabinet Bid Options
Dear Michelle,
I am writing to confirm the approved metering cabinet options for bidding. The approved cabinets are the
Durham APX3622522 and the Hubbell ME321166XXXXGMMTN1, and I will include both options in the bid
process. These are the only two types of cabinets that MTE maintains on their system. The poles and CTs are
maintained by Middle Tennessee Electric, and they are the only provider who can work on this transition from
poles to cabinets. Due to the work, MTE is the sole-source provider of material and work.
The Hubbell cabinet may need to be custom ordered, as it does not appear to come standard with a floor on
the metering side. If Hubbell can provide a custom cabinet with a floor on the metering side, it will remain a
viable option. The Durham cabinet comes standard with a floor on the metering side, which may make it the
more cost-effective option.
The floor on the metering side is necessary to help prevent snakes and other rodents from entering the
cabinet area where exposed wires are present. In short, I will bid the cabinets between Hubbell and Durham,
provided Hubbell can add a floor to the metering side of the cabinet. We prefer to use Oldcastle for our
concrete structures, so Oldcastle will provide the ground sleeve. Middle Tennessee Electric will conduct the
labor for the project with an all-in agreed upon $50,000 or less cost.
Sincerely,
Todd Palmer
Key Accounts Coordinator
Middle Tennessee Electric

June 8, 2026
TO: Board of Mayor and Aldermen
FROM: Glenn E. Johnson Jr., Chief Fire Department
SUBJECT: Sole-source purchase from Allsource Enterprises LLC dba Safe Industries of Easley, South
Carolina of 37sets of Turnout Gear in the total amount of $136,160.00 for the Operations
Division of the Fire Department ($222,000.00 budgeted in 110-83265-42200 for fiscal year
26FY)
Purpose
The new equipment would replace the existing 37 sets of turnout gear that is scheduled this current fiscal year to
be removed from service.
Financial Impact
The Fire Department operations budget for fiscal year 26 allocates $222,000.00 out of the general Fund for the
purchase of turn out gear. The budget amount was based on 37 units at a budgeted unit price of $3,680.00 each.
Recommendation
Staff recommends that the Board of Mayor and Aldermen acknowledge receipt of this report of sole-source
purchase from Allsource Enterprises LLC dba Safe Industries of Easley, South Carolina in the total amount of
$136,100.00 of 37 sets of Globe Turn out gear for use at the City’s fire stations, for the Fire Department. The Fire
Department proposes to purchase 37 units at this unit price, so the total value of the purchase would be
$136,160.00. Purchasing Manager Wesley Wright is of the opinion that the proposed sole-source purchase
appears to be justified based upon the supporting letter from the equipment manufacturer and to maintain
adherence to NFPA equipment standards. The staff recommendation appears to be made in a fair and impartial
manner based upon the information presented.

2-MAY-2025
TO: Board of Mayor and Aldermen
FROM: Eric S. Stuckey, City Administrator
Kristine Brock, Assistant City Administrator / CFO
Michelle Hatcher, Water Director
Suzanne Ward, Purchasing Manager
SUBJECT: Sole-source purchase from BAR Environmental of Brentwood, Tennessee of 1 JWC Channel
Monster in the total amount of $62,930.00 for the Water Department ($90,000.00 budgeted in
431-83230-52213 for fiscal year 2024-2025.
Purpose
The purpose of this procurement is to purchase a replacement channel monster. This equipment would be used at
the water reclaim facility. The new equipment would replace the old broken channel grinder.
Background
City Purchasing Policy allows for the following category of sole-source purchases valued at or greater than $50,000
not to require individual authorization by the Board of Mayor and Aldermen (but which shall be reported to the
Board): Repairs to, maintenance of, licenses for and/or maintenance agreements for products already in use by the
City, so long as the product manufacturer representative has stated in writing that the vendor is the sole source
available to the City, and so long as the vendor has stated in writing that the quoted pricing is the lowest municipal
unit pricing available at that time and in the foreseeable future for the quantity indicated.
Staff is of the opinion that the proposed purchase, if authorized, would be a sole-source purchase. Evidence to
support this opinion includes _____.
• is unique and possesses specific characteristics required by its intended use that cannot be filled by
another product on the market. In particular, please consider:
1. whether the vendor possesses exclusive and/or predominant capabilities or the item contains a
patented feature providing a superior utility not obtainable from similar products;
2. whether the product or service is unique and easily established as one-of-a-kind;
3. whether the program requirements can be modified so that competitive products or services may be
used;
4. whether the product is available from only one source and not merchandised through wholesalers,
jobbers or retailers; and
5. whether items must be interchangeable or compatible with in-place items.
It would be good to address whether another vendor could provide the installation or if it, too, is sole-
source.
JWC has indicated in writing that the quoted unit pricing is the lowest unit pricing possible for Tennessee
municipalities at this time and in the foreseeable future for the quantity indicated.
Maintenance Manager Tyler Connolly is of the opinion that the quoted pricing is within what would be expected in
the market place for this industry at this time.
If the pricing above is accepted by the City, then the total value of the order would be $62,930.00 (30%) under
budget.
This will be a recurring purchase as the equipment gets worn out over time due to its working environment and type
of work.
Financial Impact
The Water Department budget for fiscal year 2024-2025 allocates $62,930.00 out of the Improvements Fund for
the purchase of a new channel monster. The budget amount was based on 1 unit at a budgeted unit price of
$62,930.00 each. The quoted amount is $62,930.00 (30%) under budget.
Options
Recommendation
Staff recommends that the City accept the pricing quoted by BAR Environmental of Brentwood, TN and approve
the sole-source purchase in the total amount of $62,930.00 of 1 each JWC Channel Monster for use at the City’s
Water Reclaim Facility, for the Water Department. The Water Department proposes to purchase 1units at this
unit price, so the total value of the purchase would be $62,930.00. Purchasing Manager Suzanne Ward is of the
opinion that the proposed sole-source purchase appears to be justified, and that the staff recommendation appears

matters.title: Sole-Source Purchase From Terradyne Armored Vehicles, Inc. Of Newmarket, Ontario, Canada, For One (1) Gurkha MPV Multipurpose Armored Tactical Vehicle In The Total Amount Of $352,945 For The Special Operations Unit Of The Franklin Police Department

attachments.name: Item Report
attachments.text:
City of Franklin 109 3rd Ave S.
Franklin, TN 37064
(615) 791-3217
File #: 21-0735
DATE: September 4, 2024
TO: Board of Mayor and Aldermen
FROM: Eric Stuckey, City Administrator
Deb Faulkner, Police Chief
SUBJECT:
Sole-Source Purchase From Terradyne Armored Vehicles, Inc. Of Newmarket, Ontario, Canada, For
One (1) Gurkha MPV Multipurpose Armored Tactical Vehicle In The Total Amount Of $352,945 For
The Special Operations Unit Of The Franklin Police Department
PURPOSE:
The purpose of this memorandum is to provide information to the Franklin Board of Mayor and
Aldermen (BOMA) concerning the purpose of this procurement is to purchase one (1) Gurkha MPV
multipurpose armored tactical vehicle for the Special Operations unit of the Police Department. This
equipment would be used during high-impact calls, active shooter threats, severe weather events as
a safe rescue vehicle, off-road situations, or to move into safety rescue / recover someone in a
hazardous situation. The new equipment would be an addition to the Police Department’s fleet of
vehicles.
BACKGROUND/STAFF COMMENTS:
City Purchasing Policy allows for the following category of sole-source purchases valued at or greater
than $50,000.00 not to require individual authorization by the Board of Mayor and Aldermen (but
which shall be reported to the Board):
The sole-source basis for pricing should be used only if necessary or financially advantageous to the
City. Except when financially advantageous to the City to do otherwise, purchases that qualify as
sole-source are to be based on sole-source pricing only if another policy-compliant basis for pricing
(e.g., federal General Services Administration (GSA) via GSA contract, State of Tennessee via
Tennessee statewide contract (SWC), one of the cooperative purchasing arrangements recognized
by the City) is not known to be available.
Staff was able to determine that the Gurkha MPV multipurpose armored tactical vehicle could be
purchased with federal GSA contract MAS 23V: GS-30F-040BA as the basis for pricing. However, as
the pricing ($368,945.00) available via that GSA contract would be financially disadvantageous to the
City by $16,000.00 (4.5%), staff has placed the order direct from the manufacturer with a sole-source
as the basis for pricing.
City of Franklin Page 1 of 2
Based on research by Police staff, Police staff are of the opinion that the quoted pricing is within what
would be expected in the marketplace for this industry at this time.
FINANCIAL IMPACT:
The Police Department Patrol division budget for fiscal year 2025 allocates $354,000.00 out of the
Facilities Tax Fund for the purchase of one (1) armored vehicle. At $352,945.00, the total value of the

PURPOSE:
The purpose of this memorandum is to provide information to the Franklin Board of Mayor and
Aldermen (BOMA) concerning Contract No. 2023-0360, with Microsoft for Support Services &
Technical Account Manager.
BACKGROUND/STAFF COMMENTS:
Microsoft Unified (Premier) Services Support & Technical Account Manager; This service provides a
technical manager dedicated to City of Franklin, direct support, and escalation with Microsoft
engineers to address key complex issues. It also provides monthly strategic meetings and security
initiatives with implementation support provided by Microsoft to assist in addressing technical security
concerns in our environment.
Our Purchasing Dept. has advised this is a Sole-Source Purchase.
FINANCIAL IMPACT:
Contract Amount is $87,420.00 and is approved under the General Fund of the IT Department (110-
82560-41350).
RECOMMENDATION:
Staff recommends that the Board of Mayor and Aldermen acknowledge Contract No. 2023-0360,
previously approved by the City Administrator.
